$comment: Single source of truth for Ad Astra UI templates (plan §3). Edit this file, then run `npm run capture-templates` and `npm run registry` in tests/ui-visual. Generated files: design/templates/**/README.md (template records), design/templates/**/approved/*, design/TEMPLATE_REGISTRY.md.

tabler.name: Tabler (HTML dashboard UI kit, Bootstrap 5)
tabler.use: Primary design system. Plain HTML/CSS, so markup and SCSS can be adapted into Razor components (credit in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). The demo's promo banner and 'customize' button are vendor chrome and are hidden before capture.

judge0-ide.name: Judge0 IDE
judge0-ide.use: Primary reference for the student coding workspace layout (editor + input + output panels).

monaco.name: Monaco Editor playground
monaco.use: The code editor component itself (Decision D-UI, Option A).

shadcn-ui.name: shadcn/ui examples
shadcn-ui.use: Alternative candidate for comparison. React + Tailwind, so layout reference only; markup is not directly reusable in Razor.

elements.name: Login
elements.adopt: Centered single card, logo above, email/password, remember-me, primary full-width button.
elements.change: Ad Astra icon and navy/cyan tokens; username instead of email; no social sign-in; no sign-up link (accounts are created by a teacher).

elements.name: Startup / Splash
elements.usedBy: App launch while database and toolchains initialise
elements.adopt: Centered logo with a thin progress indicator.
elements.change: Show the current startup step text (database, toolchains) under the bar.

elements.name: Error Page
elements.adopt: Large status code, short explanation, one primary recovery action.
elements.change: Add 'Copy diagnostic report' secondary action (redacted, plan §14).

elements.name: Toolchain Status
elements.usedBy: Teachers/admin checking C, C++, Java, Python, C# toolchains
elements.adopt: Per-service status rows with up/down indicator and detail text.
elements.change: One row per language: detected version, path, status badge, 'how to fix' link when missing.

elements.name: First-Run Setup Wizard
elements.adopt: Numbered steps with one form per step and back/next actions.
elements.change: Steps: welcome → toolchain detection → first teacher account → backup location → done.

elements.name: Teacher Dashboard
elements.adopt: Sidebar shell, KPI cards row, recent-activity table, chart card.
elements.change: KPIs: active assessments, submissions today, average score, toolchain health. Fewer charts.

elements.name: Assessment List
elements.adopt: Filterable table with status badges, search, pagination and row actions.
elements.change: Columns: title, language(s), status (draft/published/closed), questions, attempts, updated.

elements.name: Assessment Editor
elements.adopt: Two-column form layout with grouped cards and a sticky save bar.
elements.change: Groups: details, timing, scoring, submission rules; question list in a side column.

elements.name: Question Editor
elements.usedBy: Teacher writing a problem statement, starter code and test cases
elements.adopt: Rich-text/markdown editing card with toolbar.
elements.change: Tabs: Statement (markdown) | Starter code (Monaco) | Test cases (table) | Scoring.

elements.name: Account Management
elements.adopt: User grid/list with avatar, role, status and actions.
elements.change: List view (not cards) for classes of 40+; bulk import; reset-password action.

elements.name: Backup & Restore
elements.adopt: Settings page: left settings nav, right content cards with actions.
elements.change: Cards: create backup, backup history table, restore (with destructive confirm).

elements.name: Assessment Report
elements.adopt: Analytics dashboard: KPI row, charts, ranked table.
elements.change: Score distribution, per-question pass rate, per-test failure hotspots.

elements.name: Gradebook
elements.usedBy: Teacher viewing scores per student x assessment
elements.adopt: Dense data grid with sortable columns.
elements.change: Students as rows, assessments as columns, export action.

elements.name: Submission Review
elements.adopt: Read-only code pane beside an output/results pane.
elements.change: Code read-only; right pane shows per-test results including hidden tests (teacher only).

elements.name: Student Dashboard
elements.adopt: Three-column board (Upcoming / In progress / Completed) of cards with meta row and actions. Chosen over the job-listing candidate because the columns map 1:1 to attempt states.
elements.change: Cards = assigned assessments: due time, duration, language, status, Start/Resume. No images, likes or comments.

elements.name: Assessment Lobby
elements.adopt: Readable long-form text column.
elements.change: Instructions, rules, time limit summary, 'Start assessment' confirm button.

elements.name: Coding Workspace
elements.adopt: Editor-dominant split layout with input/output panels and a top action bar (language, run).
elements.change: Add left problem panel, top timer bar, question navigator, visible-test results panel, Submit button. Drop Judge0's AI-assistant panel, 'Sign in with Puter' and minimap (not allowed in an exam).

elements.name: Results
elements.usedBy: Student viewing a finished attempt (when allowed)
elements.adopt: Summary stat cards plus a detail list.
elements.change: Score, tests passed, time used; per-question breakdown; hidden tests shown only as counts.

elements.name: System Health
elements.adopt: Status list with uptime-style indicators.
elements.change: Rows: app version, DB/migrations, disk, settings, toolchains.

elements.name: Log Explorer
elements.adopt: Log list with severity, timestamp and message.
elements.change: Filters by severity/component/run ID; copy redacted report.

elements.name: Test Runner
elements.adopt: Checklist rows with pass/fail state.
elements.change: Rows per test with duration and failure message expander.

elements.name: Navigation Sidebar
elements.adopt: Dark vertical sidebar: logo top, icon + label nav items, active highlight.
elements.change: Role-specific items; user/sign-out at bottom.

elements.name: Top Bar
elements.adopt: Slim top header with page title area and user menu.
elements.change: Breadcrumb/page title left; status indicators (toolchains, sync) right.

elements.name: Content Area + Page Header
elements.adopt: Page header (pretitle, title, actions) above a fluid card grid.
elements.change: None beyond tokens.

elements.name: Code Editor Panel
elements.adopt: Monaco with line numbers, minimap off, dark theme.
elements.change: Ad Astra editor theme colours; font size control; no minimap.

elements.name: Buttons
elements.adopt: Primary, secondary, outline, ghost, danger, icon buttons, loading state.
elements.change: Ad Astra blue primary, cyan focus ring.

elements.name: Form Controls (text, select, checkbox, radio, switch)
elements.adopt: Label above input, help text, invalid state with message.
elements.change: Tokens only.

elements.name: Password Field
elements.adopt: Show/hide toggle and strength meter.
elements.change: Strength meter only on create/change password.

elements.name: Card
elements.adopt: Header/body/footer card, status top border.
elements.change: Tokens only.

elements.name: Data Table
elements.adopt: Striped/hover table, sortable headers, row actions, pagination.
elements.change: Sticky header for long lists.

elements.name: Status Badge
elements.adopt: Soft-colour pill badges.
elements.change: Fixed status palette: draft, published, closed, passed, failed, hidden, running, timeout.

elements.name: Toast
elements.adopt: Top-right stacked toasts with icon and close.
elements.change: Never used for exam-critical messages (those use dialogs).

elements.name: Modal Dialog
elements.usedBy: Confirms, create/edit dialogs, submit, time expired
elements.adopt: Centered modal, status-coloured top strip for danger/success.
elements.change: Destructive confirms require typing the item name.

elements.name: Tabs
elements.adopt: Card-header tabs.
elements.change: Tokens only.

elements.name: Empty State
elements.adopt: Icon/illustration, title, one-line explanation, primary action.
elements.change: Ad Astra line icons, no stock illustrations.

elements.name: Loading / Skeleton
elements.adopt: Skeleton placeholders and spinner.
elements.change: Execution 'running…' state uses spinner + elapsed time.

elements.name: Alert / Validation Summary
elements.adopt: Important alerts with icon, title and description.
elements.change: Compiler-error variant uses monospace body.

elements.name: Steps / Progress Tracker
elements.adopt: Numbered/dotted step indicator.
elements.change: Question navigator shows answered/unanswered/flagged.

elements.name: Charts
elements.adopt: Simple bar/line/donut charts inside cards.
elements.change: Ad Astra chart palette; must work offline (bundled library).

elements.name: Dropdown Menu
elements.usedBy: Row actions, user menu, language selector
elements.adopt: Icon + label menu items, dividers.
elements.change: Tokens only.

elements.name: Pagination
elements.adopt: Prev/next with page numbers.
elements.change: Tokens only.

elements.name: Progress Bar
elements.adopt: Thin progress bars with labels.
elements.change: Timer warning (amber) and expired (red) states.

elements.name: Segmented Control
elements.adopt: Inline segmented choice.
elements.change: Tokens only.

elements.name: Number / Duration Input
elements.adopt: Stepper input.
elements.change: Duration variant (hh:mm).

elements.name: Avatar
elements.adopt: Initials avatars.
elements.change: Initials only, no photos (privacy, offline).
